HEADLESS.description: Run Chrome headless (agents can override with show_browser).

LOGIN_EMAIL.description: Email for scripted login (required when AUTO_LOGIN_ENABLED is true).

NOTEBOOK_URL.description: Legacy default notebook (library usage is recommended instead).

LOGIN_PASSWORD.description: Password for scripted login (required when AUTO_LOGIN_ENABLED is true).

SESSION_TIMEOUT.description: Inactive seconds before a session auto-closes.
